text.text: The Sharp MZ-80K was released in 1978 as part of Sharp's MZ series of personal computers. It was sold as a complete computer system with built-in keyboard, monitor, and cassette storage. The machine was popular among hobbyists and programmers in Japan due to its expandability and simple architecture. Software included programming tools, utilities, and early games. The MZ series helped establish Sharp as a major Japanese computer manufacturer.
